Contents

Pick a section to jump straight to it. With the neural band: swipe up / down to move the highlight, pinch to select.

Reading with the neural band

The band's gestures arrive as arrow keys and Enter — this whole reader is built around them.

Swipe ◀ ▶
Turn the page back / forward. Works anywhere on the reading screen.
Swipe ▲ ▼
In “Fit width” view, scroll up / down the page. At the bottom of a page, ▼ turns to the next one.
Pinch (Enter)
Activate whatever is highlighted — a button, a contents entry, the page box.
Tab / Shift+Tab
Move the highlight between the on-screen controls (Zoom, Contents, page box, Prev / Next).
Tap page edge
The left and right edges of the page also turn pages, for touch or a tap gesture.

Keyboard equivalents: ← / → turn pages, ↑ / ↓ scroll, Home / End jump to the first / last page, + / − change zoom. Your place is kept while the app stays open — reopening starts at page 1.
